method.real_stacking: Real stacking preserves the sum of squared complex column norms.
method.normalization: Both resolutions use the same fine target norm per frequency for target_relative spectra.
method.certainly_at_or_below: sigma_i(fine)+delta <= threshold*max(0,sigma_0(fine)-delta); dimension-forced zeros are exact
method.scope: A bound on measured coarse/fine spectral changes only; not a continuum discretization error bound, statistical usable rank, or nonlinear recovery certificate.
